title: Mind-map pbt export script does not run as-is
description:
Found converting examples/podcast from circular_saw_pipeline.py (the exporter lives outside this repo).
1. Wrong extras instructions: header says agent_modal + call agent_exec.use_run; bullet is agent37, auto-loaded via entry point. Install line should be prompt-build-tool[extras]; AGENT37_API_KEY never mentioned.
2. pip install prompt-build-tool does not install anthropic, but llm_call imports it -> ModuleNotFoundError.
3. Lost @reference: 'write the 2nd section for' has no ref(), so section 2 is written blind (no outline, no section 1).
4. Test bullet exported as a normal model: runs in pbt run, never in pbt test; uses {pass,reason} JSON not pbt's {results}; global_instruction=False passes a bool where pbt expects str/callable.
5. Dead code: wants_json computed but unused (JSON tests get no JSON mode); PROMPTDATA coding_instructions/llm_model unused; GLOBAL_INSTRUCTION=None.
6. Hardcoded stale model claude-sonnet-4-5; model names are truncated slugs with random suffixes (write_the_1st_section_for_ugikcubdqgco92); session id ties the audio bullet to one mind-map node.
7. No .env loading; keys must be exported by hand.
